description: Report a domain's modern email-security records beyond SPF/DMARC/DKIM: MTA-STS (DNS record + fetched policy: enforce/testing mode, max_age, MX), TLS-RPT (reporting address) and BIMI (brand logo + VMC), with warnings on what is missing or weak. Read-only DNS plus one GET of the public MTA-STS policy file.
name: email_posture
